params._comment: R27 (§17.3 fork (a)): the Cell's play loop over the duck's map vocabulary -- the node is the map EPM's winner (pi_cell_size 0), the value field is the place TLE, the climb is the bearing to the most novel reachable node (wander_stall_ticks 0: the Cell's A2, so the climb engages). Its bearing sets the adapter's heading reference (sense slot 10); the heading prior turns the body. The loop the Cell dropped is the loop the duck wants: coverage is its goal.

The sweep's cloud, opened by the body's own stillness and cached by the map's place (§17.28-17.29). A small object is sub-pixel in one cast and tens of points in a sweep, so this is the level at which one exists. T1 (2026-09-15): the stack rule (§17.31) runs in the module on the open cloud; the nearest SMALL cluster is attended, its world-sized descriptor goes to the thing EPM and its body-frame bearing to percept.thing_bearing (VisualBearing's shape). Nothing consumes the bearing yet: T1 is passive.

The object vocabulary, over the CLOUD's reduction rather than a single frame. Measured (§17.29): 16 nodes all baked, 7 winner switches a minute against a place map's 60-130, and 98 % of the object information that survives knowing the body's pose (a raw 8x8 frame gets 55 %).

The vocabulary of THINGS (things phase T1): one token per tick while a small cluster is attended, [top, footprint, aspect, columns, hits per column, chain, range, lowest height], world-sized and without a bearing. Its transition term measures the attended thing's stability from one recompute to the next, which is the precision an approach would raise; its TLE at the attended thing is the pull T2 will use.

O62: the KIND -- the same descriptor as thing_epm, at most 4 nodes and a coarse insertion floor, so its winner is the kind of thing (ball / block / a wall base) rather than one of ~30 views of it. The outcome loop keys its table by this token.

T2: the seek loop. While CloudMap attends a small thing (at a stop) the loop fixes its position by dead reckoning; when the cloud closes and the body walks it homes to that position, re-aiming as the body turns, and drops it on arrival (0.25 m) or after ~60 s. Its need is the confidence in the held target; its honest signal the range left.
seeking works while the range to the target FALLS under its own drive (sign -1).

R28's precision race with SEEK on the vision channel: G_seek = seek need x seek trust, G_play = (1 - seek need) x play trust. No avoidance loop: klino's trust key is absent, so it never wins; avoidance stays the twist brain's proximity prior (and the --seek-gate lever releases it toward the thing).

Learning what the kick does (O54). At an arrival, if the reached thing's node has fewer than two recorded outcomes, or a spread above the mean spread over nodes, the loop asks for a kick on intent.skill (the side by the thing's bearing); the host fires it from standing at the stop's hand-back. The thing's next sighting within 0.6 m of where it was, inside 30 s, is the outcome; unseen = unknown, not zero. The surprise against the node's own spread is published on reality.cognitive.outcome.
